AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  Hilton Hotel
  100 W. Glenoaks Blvd., Montrose A&B Executive Meeting Center (In lower lobby level)
  Glendale, CA 91202
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION.
  THE MEETING IS OPEN TO THE PUBLIC BUT NOT TELEVISED.
 If you have any questions about matters on the agenda,or requests for assistance, please contact
  the City Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  August 29, 2024

ROLL CALL
  - 1:30 PM
  - Report of the City Clerk of the City Council, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the
  Thursday, August 29, 2024 Special Public Meeting of the City Council was posted on
  August 27, 2024, on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

  A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council is hereby called to meet at 1:30
  PM on Thursday, August 29, 2024, in the Hilton Hotel, 100 W. Glenoaks Blvd, Glendale, CA
  91202 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;

CLOSED SESSION:
  1. Public Employee Performance Evaluation – City Manager and City Attorney

OPEN SESSION:
  1. Council Governance Workshop including discussion of roles of Council and City
  Manager/staff, best governance practices, and norms and protocols (including Code of
  Conduct)

 ADJOURNMENT

  ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SERVICE
Members of the public may address the City Council regarding any item in this notice. Service of the
above Call for a Special Public Meeting of the City Council, at the time and place above designated, is
hereby acknowledged, and the Notice required by Government Code Section 54956 is hereby waived:
Hour:  a.m./p.m., this  day of  , 20 .
By  Title: City Council Member
